title: 入职同期群90及180日留任
context: 人资部门希望判断不同入职部门的新人留任。
requirements: 以首次任职部门为入职部门；按入职季度与部门分组；只纳入截至2025年底已有90/180日观察期的员工；终止日等于观察日算不在职；返回两个分母和留任率。
commonError: 把未达到观察期限的员工当作未留任会使新同期群率偏低。
executionSteps: 在各自分母上计算留任
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT e.employee_id,h.department_id,e.hire_date,e.termination_date,d.day_index hire_idx,t.day_index term_idx,CONCAT(SUBSTR(e.hire_date,1,4),'-Q',CASE WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='03' THEN '1' WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='06' THEN '2' WHEN SUBSTR(e.hire_date,6,2)<='09' THEN '3' ELSE '4' END) cohort FROM employees e JOIN employment_history h ON h.employee_id=e.employee_id AND h.start_date=e.hire_date JOIN calendar_days d ON d.day=e.hire_date LEFT JOIN calendar_days t ON t.day=e.termination_date), b AS (SELECT department_id,cohort,SUM(CASE WHEN hire_idx+90<=1095 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n90,SUM(CASE WHEN hire_idx+90<=1095 AND (term_idx IS NULL OR term_idx>hire_idx+90) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r90,SUM(CASE WHEN hire_idx+180<=1095 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) n180,SUM(CASE WHEN hire_idx+180<=1095 AND (term_idx IS NULL OR term_idx>hire_idx+180) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) r180 FROM a GROUP BY department_id,cohort) SELECT department_id,cohort,n90,ROUND(100.0*r90/NULLIF(n90,0),2) retention90_pct,n180,ROUND(100.0*r180/NULLIF(n180,0),2) retention180_pct FROM b ORDER BY department_id,cohort
